title: Interaction Overview Tour
description: Create and edit interaction records including meetings, calls, emails, and other communications with partners and contacts. Supports AI transcription and file attachments.

popover.title: Welcome to InteractionModalComponent
popover.description: This modal allows users to create new interaction records or edit existing ones. It supports various communication types like meetings, calls, and emails, and includes features for adding participants, uploading documents, and leveraging AI for transcription to automatically populate details.

popover.title: Delete
popover.description:
Permanently deletes an interaction record after a confirmation dialog. Use with caution as this action cannot be undone.

When to use: When an interaction was recorded incorrectly or is no longer relevant and needs to be removed from the system.

popover.title: Save | Create Interaction
popover.description:
Saves or creates an interaction record with all form data, including participants, documents, and interaction details.

When to use: When all required fields are filled and you want to save the interaction to the system.

popover.title: Process Transcription
popover.description:
Processes AI transcription results from uploaded audio, image, or text files and automatically fills relevant form fields with extracted interaction data.

When to use: After uploading an audio recording, image, or text file from an interaction to automatically extract and populate details using AI.

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of Interaction. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
